source.notes: Verified 2026-07-01 by pypdf extraction of the OSTI PDF, Sec. 3.24: 'Our fitted Birch-Murnaghan parameters are V0 = 7.230 cm3/mol, B0 = 193.5 GPa, and B0-prime = 4.934.' unresolved.note: Only a coarse 2-significant-figure CRC value (160 GPa) was verifiable; Cr is absent from the precise ultrasonic benchmark tabulations fetched this session, and the LLNL DAC fit gives a conflicting 193.5 GPa. Precise ultrasonic-grade B0 for Cr: unresolved.
No verifiable DAC B0-prime for fcc Ca (complex phase diagram above ~20 GPa; Young et al. cite Anderson/Gu data but quote no fit parameters).
Same as Ca: at least five phases below 100 GPa; no verifiable fit parameters.
Young et al. use Ding et al. compression data for V but quote no fit parameters; V also has a rhombohedral transition near 60 GPa. Unresolved.
